- tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py:1544-1560 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts the workflow source contains `'Codex exited with code $cmd_rc and returned empty output'`, which this reviewer says will fail on legitimate watchdog-killed runs.
  WHY: The reviewer treated the `$cmd_rc` reference as a runtime mismatch; other reviewers rejected this as a false positive because the check reads raw YAML source text.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1041-1042 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The exec-history extraction truncates command text with `substr(cmd, 1, 500)`, so long MCP calls lose later arguments in retry context.
  WHY: Reviewers described this as a low-to-medium utility issue, though one related truncation change in an older line range was marked out of scope.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1309-1338 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostics awk replaces matched stderr lines with only `<redacted: secret-like key>`, dropping line-number/context metadata.
  WHY: This makes it harder to correlate repeated failures across the 40-line stderr tails, though reviewers treated it as a security-first tradeoff.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1203-1210 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The new empty-output handling counts non-zero empty runs as empty, but the preceding salvage branch only keys off `cmd_rc != 0`, so the two paths may interact incorrectly.
  WHY: Only one reviewer raised this potential mismatch, so confidence is low.
